title: Conformal Robustness in Prediction-Driven Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2609.23170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern prediction-driven decision systems often rely on black-box predictors, but a point forecast alone does not provide the uncertainty scale required for robust downstream decision-making. We build a score-calibrated robustness framework that converts any fixed point predictor into a decision-relevant uncertainty representation through distribution-free conformal calibration. We use the conformal score, rather than a particular uncertainty set, as the primitive unit of robustness. The same score determines coverage-calibrated uncertainty sets for reliability-based robust optimization and normalizes target violations in a target-oriented formulation, Conformal Robust Satisficing. This formulation induces a conformal fragility measure that quantifies how rapidly performance deteriorates as the realized parameter departs from the forecast on the conformal score scale. For objective-uncertainty problems under standard convexity and dual

translated_title: 预测驱动决策中的保形鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 现代预测驱动的决策系统通常依赖黑箱预测器，但仅凭点预测无法提供鲁棒下游决策所需的不确定性尺度。我们构建了一个分数校准的鲁棒性框架，通过无分布假设的保形校准，将任意固定的点预测器转化为与决策相关的不确定性表示。我们以保形分数（而非特定不确定性集合）作为鲁棒性的基本单元。同一分数既可确定基于可靠性鲁棒优化中覆盖率校准的不确定性集合，又可在面向目标的公式化方法——保形鲁棒满意化中归一化目标违反程度。该公式化诱导出一种保形脆弱性度量，用以量化当实际参数在保形分数尺度上偏离预测时性能恶化的速度。对于满足标准凸性与对偶条件的客观不确定性问题……
tldr: 该论文提出以保形分数为基本单元的分数校准鲁棒性框架，通过无分布保形校准将黑箱点预测器转化为决策相关的不确定性表示，统一支撑基于可靠性的鲁棒优化与保形鲁棒满意化，并引入保形脆弱性度量来量化性能随实际参数偏离预测而恶化的速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a score-calibrated robustness framework that takes the conformal score as the primitive unit of robustness, converting any black-box point predictor into a decision-relevant uncertainty representation via distribution-free conformal calibration, unifying reliability-based robust optimization and Conformal Robust Satisficing, and introducing a conformal fragility measure that quantifies how rapidly performance deteriorates as the realized parameter departs from the forecast.
